domain: Draws one page of the Psynergy list, including PP cost, range, and the selected owner's name, class, and level.
expressed: dereferences the mode-owned PsynergyMenuState at Data_03001f2c and resolves menu->owner_ids[0] through Runtime_GetObject
commits the window and computes first = result->page*5 and rows = min(result->entry_count-first, 5)
positions the page icons, draws the page indicator, and draws message 0xAED, which the local message archive identifies as 'PP'
loops over up to five entries of menu->psynergies[], masks each action id with 0x3fff, and draws its action-name message and BattleAction.pp_cost
converts BattleAction.range to the three-tile range marker index, preserving the 0xff sentinel-to-11 behavior
draws message 0xAEF, 'You have no Psynergy.', when menu->psynergy_count is zero
draws the owner's name string, class-name message, the ROM string 'Lv', and the owner's level byte
always returns 1, matching the menu page callback convention

decoder_signals: reciprocal mask/item register roles at the indexed halfword load
conditional value and result occupied different lifetimes
row-coordinate setup outranked the masked-message argument
register_gate_step4.source_edit: Inline the two indexed halfword loads with the offset-first address spelling, materialize msg before calculating y, and load act->range into range before mutating it in place.
register_gate_step4.compiler_effect: The mask remains the r0 result carrier, range remains one r4 carrier through compare and decrement, and msg makes GCC schedule the indexed load/mask before the row-coordinate shift.

notes: The inventory-menu page family supplied the compiler shape only: page math and the paging helpers are shared. The mode-owned Data_03001f2c view, message text, action fields, and surrounding PsynergyMenu callers establish that this owner belongs to psynergy_menu.

PsynergyMenuState independently fixes psynergies at 0x1c8, psynergy_count at 0x218, and owner_ids[0] at 0x21a. The local message archive identifies 0xAED as 'PP', 0xAEF as 'You have no Psynergy.', 0x333 as the action-name table base, and 0x741 as the class-name table base.

BattleAction establishes range at +8 and pp_cost at +9. The local ROM bytes at 0x080AF22C are the NUL-terminated ASCII string 'Lv'. The three 0x08015xxx veneer targets are the exact adopted string/number drawing owners, not portrait or icon routines.

The byte-exact repair keeps the menu-relative offset loads, materializes msg before y, and mutates one range carrier in place. Those ordinary C choices close the former allocation/scheduling floor without annotations, register hints, or compiler overrides.

Recovered only from the retained owner assembly, approved local ROM and message archive, already-adopted Psynergy/menu/text sources, in-repo headers, and the approved compiler. No external decompilation or symbol map was consulted.
